name: CAP Command Chief Master Sergeant white chevron (mess dress), 3.5 in
size_citation: DAFI 36-2903 4.1.1.3 / 4.1.2.3 and CAPR 39-1 4.1.1.1.1.4 (men 4 in white chevron) / 4.1.2.1.1.4 (women 3 1/2 or 4 in white chevron); outline and proportions from Fig A5-4
provenance: rank-senior-command-chief-chevron-3p5in with the dark blue field removed and the stripes, letters and emblem in white: the mess dress sleeve is dark blue, so the chevron is white only (no regulation figure of the white chevron; colour is the regulation word "white")

dimensions.form: white embroidered chevron (mess dress only), no field

mounts.rule: centred on the outer arm halfway between the shoulder seam and the elbow bent at 90 degrees (4.1.1.1.1.4, 4.1.2.1.1.4); mess dress only

first_sergeant_note: the first sergeant diamond applies to cadet first sergeants (CAPR 39-1 10.10.4), who wear metal chevrons and no mess dress chevron; not built for the senior chevrons
